title: Almighty Push
body:
Syntax: perform almighty push <target>

Description: Release Rinnegan gravity against one target in your room, dealing chakra damage with a chance to throw it off balance. This implementation does not move the target to a different room. Base damage: 1509-1789. 60% chance to inflict off balance. Unlocks at level 75 only for Indra reincarnations of any combat class. Requires your Six Paths mode active. Train and use the technique to increase its mastery. Costs 100 Chakra and 10 Stamina; 20 second cooldown.

Date: 2026-09-27
